prompt: Create an original 90 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A smooth, chill jazz-funk track with a relaxed groove, featuring piano, electric guitar, bass, drums, and subtle orchestral elements.
